enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe. Turn to side. Pull blanket. Adjust pillow. Remain asleep. Shift position. Move arm. Move leg. Turn head. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up and taking a morning shower
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Turn off stove. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Select shirt and pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out bag. Place laptop in bag. Place notebook in bag. Zip bag.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk to office. Enter building. Greet receptionist. Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office coordinating community programs
enriched_activities.desc: Check emails. Reply to emails. Make phone calls. Attend meeting. Take notes. Update program schedule. Coordinate with volunteers. Print documents. File papers. Organize desk. Talk to colleague. Drink water. Use computer. Send messages.

Walk to cafeteria. Buy lunch. Sit at table. Unpack lunch. Open container. Eat sandwich. Drink juice. Talk to coworker. Wipe mouth. Clean up. Throw away trash. Check phone. Walk back to office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office, running program meetings and updating schedules
enriched_activities.desc: Lead meeting. Present slides. Answer questions. Assign tasks. Update calendar. Send email. Call partner. Review budget. Sign forms. Organize files. Check inventory. Meet with supervisor. Take notes. Drink coffee.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Read book. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home.
Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Flip channels. Watch news. Put feet on coffee table. Drink water. Turn off TV. Stand up.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out pot. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Chop vegetables. Cook meat. Add seasoning. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates. Load glasses. Load utensils. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter. Turn off kitchen light.
Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Select movie. Watch. Eat snack. Drink tea. Pause TV. Go to bathroom. Return. Resume TV. Check phone. Adjust volume. Change channel. Put feet up. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Adjust shower. Step into shower. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Brush teeth. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and planning the next day's program tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Pick up book. Read. Turn page. Put book down. Pick up planner. Write notes. Check phone. Set alarm. Turn off lamp. Lie down.
